liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (2 reviews): Listener loves the Ken Kesey rap performed during the Dark Star jam; Listener says the show is worth listening for just the Dark Star performance [14][15]
- **Jam** (1 review): The Jam after Dark Star is amazing; Kesey recites while band rips behind him [17]
- **Werewolves of London** (1 review): Quoted lyrics describe Buffalo Bill, his stallion, and the blue-eyed boy Mister Death [18]
- Listener calls the Throwing Stones jam insane and their favorite of the concert [21]

## The recordings

- **gd91-10-31.sbd.gardner.2897.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 21 songs; 177 min; rated 4.89/5 by 56 [1]. Said about its sound: Original tape had drops; current copy is clean and complete; Second set sparkles with small haunting moments fitting for a Halloween show; Kesey rap is intense; accompanying jam is extremely haunting [14][17][24]
- **gd1991-10-31.sbd.hinko.32241.sbeok.flac16**: soundboard; 21 songs; 180 min; rated 3.5/5 by 2 [4]. Said about its sound: No dropout in Let It Grow; discs two and three are seamless [4]
- **gd1991-10-31.mtx.haugh.gems.102251.flac24**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 177 min; rated 5/5 by 3 [2]
- **gd1991-10-31.mtx.haugh.gems.102252.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 177 min; rated 4.17/5 by 6 [3]

## Around the show

- Gary Duncan's guest spot adds life; Werewolves encore feels anticlimactic [14]
- Kesey's brief Halloween performance was unbelievable; energy high due to Bill Graham's passing [15]
- Listener sat close to stage on Phil side; parking lot had freaky costumes [16]
- Tickets were near impossible to score if not already held [16]
- Kesey acts as shaman, making things clear to the crowd [19]
- Kesey was found at a gas station pump after the show [22]
- Band follows Kesey's rant in a cosmic manner [23]
- Show occurred under less than festive circumstances following Bill's passing [24]
- Similar vibe to October 26, 1989; recommended for another freak-out session [19]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd91-10-31.sbd.gardner.2897.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [1]. Also: Soundboard transfer via Tony Gardner; chain is sbd to shn [1]
- **gd1991-10-31.sbd.hinko.32241.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by eD; source: DSBD > DAT > CD > EAC > FLAC [4]. Also: Extracted with EAC, joined with SHNtool, edited in Cool Edit Pro, encoded to FLAC [4]
- **gd1991-10-31.mtx.haugh.gems.102251.flac24**: transferred by Dan Haugh; source: SBD+AUD Matrix Mix (60% SBD & 40% AUD) Multitrack Mixdown: SBD -3db, Aud -8db [2]
- **gd1991-10-31.mtx.haugh.gems.102252.flac16**: transferred by Dan Haugh; source: SBD+AUD Matrix Mix (60% SBD & 40% AUD); Multitrack Mixdown: SBD -3db, Aud -8db; Matrix by Amdig [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Oakland Coliseum Arena - October 31, 1991](https://www.dead.net/show/october-31-1991) [31]
